List video abuse report reasons. Use this tool to list available abuse report reasons.

Usage:
  yutu videoAbuseReportReason list [flags]

Examples:
# List video abuse report reasons
yutu videoAbuseReportReason list --hl en

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for list
  -l, --hl string       Host language
  -o, --output string   json|yaml|table (default "table")
  -p, --parts strings   Comma separated parts (default [id,snippet])
